rv.q: A good parody should do more than aimlessly point at a material with a mocking laugh.
Though the storyline is new, Friends! The Musical Parody still incorporates highlights from the show's 10 seasons, including iconic lines, jokes, and references.
An irresistibly hilarious night of comedy
'Friends!' will make you laugh so hard your face will hurt, your eyes will tear, and you'll be ready to come back.

"Absolutely delivers on the promise of sending up the show...The musical happily and hysterically depicts moments from the friends’ adventures...They find the underside and ridiculousness of the sitcom plots and the cast gleefully captures the spirit, vocal and physical tics...
The majority of the songs are fantastic.
If you like the Friends TV show, you will probably enjoy Friends the Musical.
The show manages to pay homage to a classic TV show which is probably all you can ask for.
The plot points are all there, but the genuineness from the show wasn’t all that present on stage, and it made the show fall a little flat.
